00032 typedef LONG AtomicInt;

00044 #elif defined __APPLE__

00046 typedef int32_t AtomicInt;

00048 inline AtomicInt AtomicIncrement(AtomicInt &value)
00049 {

00058 #elif defined __GNUG__

00060 typedef _Atomic_word AtomicInt;
00061 
00062 inline AtomicInt AtomicIncrement(AtomicInt &value)
00063 {
00064 #if __GNUC__ * 10 + __GNUC_MINOR__ < 34
00065    return __exchange_and_add(&value, 1) + 1;
00066 #else
00067    return __gnu_cxx::__exchange_and_add(&value, 1) + 1;
00068 #endif
00069 }
00070 
00071 inline AtomicInt AtomicDecrement(AtomicInt &value)
00072 {
00073 #if __GNUC__ * 10 + __GNUC_MINOR__ < 34
00074    return __exchange_and_add(&value, -1) - 1;
00075 #else
00076    return __gnu_cxx::__exchange_and_add(&value, -1) - 1;
00077 #endif
00078 }
